examples.name: Default
examples.summary: Default large link to an off-site page; the `_blank` target adds the external-link icon.
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import Link from '@aziontech/webkit/link'
</script>

<template>
  <Link
    label="Learn more"
    size="large"
    href="https://example.com/docs"
    target="_blank"
  />
</template>

examples.name: Sizes
examples.summary: All size variants side by side.

examples.name: Disabled
examples.summary: Disabled state; interaction is blocked and the disabled tokens apply.
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import Link from '@aziontech/webkit/link'
</script>

<template>
  <Link
    label="Learn more"
    icon="pi pi-external-link"
    disabled
  />
</template>
